candidates.content: She said no to Bela in front of the whole ensemble for the first time: ohne Nebel keine Möwe, out loud, hands shaking after. The fog and Bela are one question to her, not two.
One cigarette at the loading dock on day nine. She wanted it not to count; the number is one, not zero, and not a relapse.
Ferdi still owes her 40 euro for Saturday's taxi; she wrote STILL in capitals.
Hamburg after the run, at Lotte's; Herr Brösel needs a sitter, and the sitter cannot be Ferdi.
